## Project Details
- **Type**: Standalone HTML Application (No Build Tools)
- **Framework**: React 18 via CDN
- **Dependencies**: All loaded via CDN (React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons)
- **Purpose**: Receipt splitting application for easy sharing among friends
- **Deployment**: Can be hosted on any static hosting (Netlify, GitHub Pages, Vercel, etc.)

## How to Use
1. Open `index.html` in any browser
2. No installation or Node.js required
3. Ready to deploy to free hosting platforms
